issues: No [services.postgres] block — the expected local Postgres service (supabase/postgres image in docker/docker-compose.yml) is entirely unwired
postgresql package not installed at all, so even manual `postgres`/`initdb` use is unavailable
pnpm.version = "10.24.0" likely unresolvable — catalog pnpm_10 floor is 10.25.0; corepack from nodejs_22 is the idiomatic way to honor packageManager pinning under engine-strict
Hook never uses $FLOX_ENV_CACHE (no --store-dir), so pnpm writes to the default global store outside the environment
Installs docker-compose for the self-host stack, which is out of scope for a dev environment and is neither runtime nor service
deno.systems narrowing drops x86_64-darwin without stated provenance, silently degrading the second runtime on Intel macOS
Correctly detects Node 22 + Deno and correctly avoids wiring gotrue/postgrest/realtime/storage as Flox services

results.manifest_excerpt:
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

[install]
# Node 22 — .nvmrc pins "22", package.json engines.node ">=22",
# apps/studio/Dockerfile builds on node:22-slim.
nodejs.pkg-path = "nodejs_22"

# pnpm pinned to the exact packageManager version. .npmrc sets
# engine-strict=true and engines.pnpm is "10.24", so a newer pnpm
# is rejected rather than tolerated.
pnpm.pkg-path = "pnpm_10"
pnpm.version = "10.24.0"

# Second runtime: supabase/functions/ are Deno edge functions
# (https://esm.sh/... imports), run by supabase/edge-runtime in Docker.
# Not published for Intel macOS.
deno.pkg-path = "deno"
deno.systems = ["aarch64-darwin", "aarch64-linux", "x86_64-linux"]

# DEVELOPERS.md prerequisites: make (or "build-essentials for your OS")
gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"

# Makefile targets shell out to these
jq.pkg-path = "jq"
curl.pkg-path = "curl"

# For the self-host stack under docker/ (compose files, not a Flox service)
docker-compose.pkg-path = "docker-compose"

[hook]
on-activate = '''
  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || [ pnpm-lock.yaml -nt node_modules ]; then
    pnpm install --frozen-lockfile 2>&1 | tail -3 >&2
  fi
'''

[options]
systems = [
  "aarch64-darwin",
  "aarch64-linux",
  "x86_64-darwin",
  "x86_64-linux",
]
